title: Fairness-Regularized Synthetic Tabular Data Generation
summary: A research capstone that injects fairness constraints (loss-based regularization and rejection sampling) into CTGAN to evaluate whether fairness properties transfer from synthetic to real downstream classifiers trained on the UCI Adult dataset. The project's core FairCTGAN class directly modifies the standalone ctgan package's generator loss and DataTransformer behavior, while notebooks also fall back to SDV's sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata for baseline comparisons.
evidence: src/fair_ctgan.py (Core: FairCTGAN class); scripts/train_all_models.py:35 `from ctgan import CTGAN`; notebooks use `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer`
